from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u002/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marked = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if all(v == row[0] for v in row):
            marked.update((r, c) for c in range(w))
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
            marked.update((r, c) for r in range(h))
    for r, c in marked:
        out[r][c] = 2
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-5af663e8.py'
path.write_text(code)
print(path)
